entries.pr_title: fix: prevent SimHash feature vote overflow
entries.pr_body:
## Problem

Signed 8-bit vote counters overflow within the existing 256-feature sampling budget. Repeating one shingle can reverse its sketch at 128 votes or collapse it to zero at 256 votes, allowing unrelated repeated messages to collide.

## Changes

Use signed 16-bit vote counters, which cover the full sampled vote range without changing feature sampling or the 16-character serialized sketch format.

The regression suite checks repeated Latin and CJK shingles around the 127/128 and 255/256 boundaries and across sampling strides, plus distinct unrelated sketches at the cap.

## Storage golden update

`fold-reconcile.ts` stores these same SimHash values in `metadata.foldAnchors.<id>.sh`. Correcting the arithmetic intentionally changes those persisted fingerprints. Regenerate the four storage-render golden files with the repository's `scripts/update-storage-render-goldens.ts`.

The before/after verification compared complete normalized persisted state for all four wire scenarios. Only 13 fold-anchor `sh` values changed; outbound bodies, fold/edit landmarks, state shape, block contents, stats and all other persisted fields remained unchanged. Each golden changes only `stateDigest`, `stateDigestAligned` and `sectionDigests.metadata`. No assertion or normalization rule was weakened.

[Before/after verification](https://github.com/Afloat16/claude-mem/actions/runs/42644612600/job/129254383909): the unchanged base passed all 17 storage golden/restart tests; the corrected fingerprints and regenerated goldens passed all 36 SimHash, alignment, storage-render and restart tests. Typecheck and production build also passed.

## Validation

Exact commit `c26c68a93fb11035a0e02cd08b171a295abbddb4` passed all 36 tests, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run build` in a fresh Node 22 checkout: [committed-version verification](https://github.com/Afloat16/claude-mem/actions/runs/42645200000/job/129256490757). The tracked source and golden files remained unchanged during validation. This checks the targeted and related suites plus the four-wire storage and restart contracts; the upstream full CI matrix runs independently.

## Related work

Original feature #2266; no matching vote-overflow correction was found in the upstream or prior contribution history.

Closes #6036.

## Problem

SSE dumps ignore write backpressure and resolve before file completion, while sink failures leave source readers active.

## Changes

Use Node stream pipeline to coordinate backpressure, completion and error cancellation.

Blocked low-watermark writable retains bounded read-ahead, final-flush completion is awaited, and a failing destination cancels/unlocks the upstream.
